title: THY MERCY HELD ME UP
NOON PRAYER | PSALM 94:18
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon

scenes.a: If your footing felt unsteady in that last decision, God sees your trembling steps.
His word declares: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
Lord, in this midday hour, when momentum falters and our strength wavers, grab hold of our hand.
Where we feel ourselves slipping into panic or fatigue, let your unfailing love uphold us right now.
Establish our steps, clear our thoughts, and ground our heart in your steady presence today.
Thank you for catching us before we fall. Subscribe to The Midday Watch to pause and pray with us at noon.
